questions.q: What is she making the bald head out of?
questions.e: In the video: "kako od folije da napravim ćelavu glavu" — how to make a bald head out of foil.

questions.q: Whose concert is she going to?
questions.e: In the video: "ova dama na Pitbulla ne ide ćelava" — this lady is not going to Pitbull bald.

questions.q: Why does she need cheap make-up?
o: she does not mind squeezing out a lot
questions.e: In the video: "mi nije žao da istisnem ovoga koliko god treba" — I do not mind squeezing out as much as needed.

questions.q: What does she lack for the outfit?
o: a white shirt and a black tie
questions.e: In the video: "nemam ni običnu belu košulju ni običnu crnu kravatu" — I do not have an ordinary white shirt or an ordinary black tie.
